Iteration170 removes blanket row click inference so table interior padding uses the existing BrowserWriterPointerSelectionController/selection mapper/SwEditWin/native cursor rather than selecting a whole row. Removing the row handler also removes synthetic row inference from list-marker hits. Native number labels instead invoke RulerMarginDrag/StartDocDrag(Indent); that label/ruler behavior remains unverified. The mounted injected marker caret test proves browser geometry only. Initial real-browser MKeep expectations were source-confirmed incorrect and are excluded; marker checks retain no synthetic row selection and unchanged text. The existing explicit row selector is placed in an absolute left gutter with hover/focus arrow, outside cell text and measurement flow. Actual element hit and native caret range are authoritative within the hit cell; otherwise bounded nearest paragraph and clipped native hit resolution reuse existing text-caret helper for empty/formatted boundary fallback. Browser geometry remains an explicit DOM adaptation, not full VCL layout. Existing helper is exported directly for reuse without a duplicate walker, manager, model, DTO or compatibility wrapper. New owned geometry/mounted DOM/Chromium cases verify the represented flat LTR table pointer, actual native box/caret/history and neighbor behavior. RTL/vertical/nested/merged/protected/column/resizing/full layout/portion/core/UI/list/table remain unverified; prior states/defaults/classes/IO exceptions and evidence prefixes are retained.
